question: When was the 2ⁿd battle of Tarain fought?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1192**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** 2nd Battle of Tarain **in **1192 AD**, was fought between **Prithviraj Chauhan **and **Muhammad Ghori**.

 
 
• It led to Prithviraj’s defeat and capture by Muhammad Ghori.
 
 
 
• **Prithviraja III**, a member of the **Chauhan (Chahamana) dynasty**, was a king of Sapadalaksha, with his **capital located at Ajmer, Rajasthan.**
 
 
• He was also referred to as** Prithviraj Chauhan or Rai Pithora**. Prithviraj, who **ascended **to the **throne **as a minor** in 1177 CE**, inherited a kingdom that spanned from Thanesar in the north to Jahazpur (Mewar) in the south.</li
